tasks.name: disable conflicting legacy swift services if present
tasks.args:
OUT=ABSENT
# known legacy names from earlier hand deployments on these hosts:
# the SAIO supervisor and the transient systemd-run swiftd-* units
for unit in swift-rust-saio swiftd-proxy swiftd-account swiftd-container swiftd-object; do
  if systemctl is-active "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl is-enabled "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl disable --now "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl stop "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    OUT=DISABLED
  fi
done
echo "$OUT"

tasks.name: ensure haproxy TLS staging dir on controller
generate self-signed HAProxy TLS material on first LB host
tasks.args:
set -euo pipefail
PEM="{{ haproxy_tls_pem | default('/etc/haproxy/haproxyCA.pem') }}"
CRT=/etc/haproxy/haproxy.crt
KEY=/etc/haproxy/haproxy.key
DAYS="{{ haproxy_tls_days | default(825) }}"
CN="{{ auth_url_ip }}"
if [ -f "$PEM" ] && [ -s "$PEM" ]; then
  echo TLS-PRESENT
  exit 0
fi
openssl req -new -x509 -nodes -days "$DAYS" -subj "/CN=$CN" -out "$CRT" -keyout "$KEY"
cat "$CRT" "$KEY" > "$PEM"
chmod 600 "$PEM" "$KEY"
chmod 644 "$CRT"
echo TLS-GENERATED
when: lb_mode == "https" and (haproxy_tls_pem_src | default('')) | length == 0 and (haproxy_tls_self_signed | default(true)) and inventory_hostname == groups['haproxy_servers'][0]

tasks.name: set keepalived log facility
tasks.args:
CONF=/etc/sysconfig/keepalived
LINE='KEEPALIVED_OPTIONS="-D --log-facility=1"'
if [ ! -f "$CONF" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$LINE" > "$CONF"
  echo TOGGLED
elif grep -q '^KEEPALIVED_OPTIONS=' "$CONF"; then
  if grep -qxF "$LINE" "$CONF"; then
    echo UNCHANGED
  else
    sed -i 's|^KEEPALIVED_OPTIONS=.*|'"$LINE"'|' "$CONF"
    echo TOGGLED
  fi
else
  printf '\n%s\n' "$LINE" >> "$CONF"
  echo TOGGLED
fi

tasks.name: wait for the local proxy to come up
tasks.args:
for _ in $(seq 30); do
  code=$(curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:{{ proxy_bind_port }}/healthcheck || true)
  if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
    echo UP
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "proxy did not answer /healthcheck within 30s" >&2
exit 1

tasks.name: tempauth issues a token for the first account
container PUT/GET round trip
tasks.args:
set -e
resp=$(curl -sf -m 10 -D - -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:{{ proxy_bind_port }}/auth/v1.0 \
  -H 'X-Auth-User: {{ swift_tempauth_users[0].account }}:{{ swift_tempauth_users[0].user }}' \
  -H 'X-Auth-Key: {{ swift_tempauth_users[0].key }}')
token=$(printf '%s' "$resp" | tr -d '\r' | awk 'tolower($1)=="x-auth-token:" {print $2}')
url=$(printf '%s' "$resp" | tr -d '\r' | awk 'tolower($1)=="x-storage-url:" {print $2}')
test -n "$token"
test -n "$url"
curl -sf -m 10 -X PUT "$url/swift-deploy-verify" -H "X-Auth-Token: $token" -o /dev/null
curl -sf -m 10 "$url?format=plain" -H "X-Auth-Token: $token" | grep -q '^swift-deploy-verify$'
echo ROUND-TRIP-OK

tasks.name: HTTPS VIP healthcheck via HAProxy
tasks.args:
set -e
code=$(curl -sk -m 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
  "https://{{ auth_url_ip }}:{{ swift_lb_port }}/healthcheck" || true)
if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
  echo "HTTPS VIP healthcheck failed: http_code=$code" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo HTTPS-VIP-OK

handlers.name: restart swift services
handlers.args:
units=$(systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --plain 'swift-*' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
for unit in $units; do
  systemctl try-restart "$unit"
done
echo "restarted: $units"
